title: Why Beetles Love Beer Bottles 🍺🪲
caption:
These beetles tried to mate with beer bottles. Your senses might be fooling you too.

Senses evolved for survival, not truth. Cognitive scientist Donald Hoffman says what you see may be just an interface, like icons on a desktop.

Which level broke your brain? 👇
